title: Colossians Chapter 3 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Colossians chapter 3 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Colossians Chapter 3 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Colossians Chapter 3.

questions.question: In Colossians 3, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Seek those things which are above
questions.correctAnswer: Seek those things which are above
questions.explanation: This is stated in Colossians 3:1, which is the first verse of the chapter.

questions.question: What should you set your affection on according to Colossians 3?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:2 instructs to set your affection on things above.

questions.question: According to Colossians 3:3, what is said about your life?
options: Your life is hid with Christ in God
Your life is visible to all
Your life is on the earth
Your life is full of anger
questions.correctAnswer: Your life is hid with Christ in God
questions.explanation: This is directly stated in Colossians 3:3.

questions.question: When shall you appear with Christ in glory?
options: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear
questions.correctAnswer: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:4 mentions that you will appear with Him when He appears.

questions.question: What should you mortify according to Colossians 3:5?
options: Your members which are upon the earth
questions.correctAnswer: Your members which are upon the earth
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:5 instructs to mortify your members which are upon the earth.

questions.question: Why does the wrath of God come on the children of disobedience?
questions.explanation: This is stated in Colossians 3:6, which connects the wrath of God to the previous verse.

questions.question: What does Colossians 3:7 say about the past?
options: You also walked some time, when ye lived in them
questions.correctAnswer: You also walked some time, when ye lived in them
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:7 explains that they once walked in those sinful behaviors.

questions.question: According to Colossians 3:8, what should you put off?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:8 instructs to put off all these, referencing negative behaviors.

questions.question: What should you not do to one another according to Colossians 3:9?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:9 clearly states not to lie to one another.

questions.question: According to Colossians 3:1, where does Christ sit?
options: At the right hand of God
questions.correctAnswer: At the right hand of God
questions.explanation: This is stated in Colossians 3:1, confirming Christ's position.

questions.question: According to Colossians 3:6, who are the children of disobedience?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:6 refers to children of disobedience in relation to God's wrath.

questions.question: True or False: We are told to seek things that are above in Colossians 3:1.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:1 instructs believers to seek those things which are above.

questions.question: True or False: Colossians 3:3 states that our life is hidden with Christ in God.
questions.explanation: This is directly stated in Colossians 3:3.

questions.question: True or False: Colossians 3:4 mentions that we will appear with Christ when He appears.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:4 specifically states the condition of appearing with Christ, not when He appears.

questions.question: True or False: Colossians 3:8 instructs to hold onto anger and malice.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:8 instructs to put off anger, wrath, and malice, not to hold onto them.

medium.title: Colossians Chapter 3 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Colossians Chapter 3 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What should we put on as the elect of God according to Colossians 3:12?
options: Bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind
questions.correctAnswer: Bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:12 instructs believers to put on virtues such as mercies and kindness, emphasizing their holy and beloved status.

questions.question: What does Colossians 3:11 promise will happen if someone puts on the new man mentioned in Colossians 3:10?
options: There will be neither Greek nor Jew
They will be free from sin
questions.correctAnswer: There will be neither Greek nor Jew
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:11 states that in the new man, all distinctions such as race or social status are removed, showing unity in Christ.

questions.question: What is the bond of perfectness according to Colossians 3:14?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:14 identifies charity (love) as the essential bond that holds perfect unity among believers.

questions.question: What does Colossians 3:15 say should rule in your hearts?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:15 emphasizes that the peace of God should govern our hearts, fostering unity and gratitude amongst believers.

questions.question: According to Colossians 3:13, how should we treat one another?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:13 instructs believers to bear with and forgive each other, following Christ's example of forgiveness.

questions.question: What is encouraged in Colossians 3:16 regarding the word of Christ?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:16 encourages believers to let the word of Christ dwell richly within them, promoting wisdom and teaching.

questions.question: What should we do in all our actions according to Colossians 3:17?
options: Do all in the name of the Lord Jesus
questions.correctAnswer: Do all in the name of the Lord Jesus
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:17 commands believers to conduct all their actions in the name of Jesus, emphasizing a life of gratitude and purpose.

questions.question: What does Colossians 3:18 instruct wives to do?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:18 instructs wives to submit to their own husbands, aligning with God's order for the family.

questions.question: What does Colossians 3:10 say has happened to the new man?
options: He has been renewed in knowledge
questions.correctAnswer: He has been renewed in knowledge
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:10 explains that the new man is renewed in knowledge, reflecting the image of the Creator.

questions.question: What is the relationship described in Colossians 3:11?
options: Christ is all and in all
questions.correctAnswer: Christ is all and in all
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:11 emphasizes that Christ is central and present in all believers, breaking down social and ethnic barriers.

questions.question: What should govern our relationships according to Colossians 3:14?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:14 states that charity is the bond of perfectness, essential for healthy relationships among believers.

questions.question: According to Colossians 3:15, what should we be?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:15 encourages believers to be thankful, reflecting a heart of gratitude towards God and each other.

questions.question: True or False: Colossians 3:13 teaches that we should hold grudges against each other.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:13 directs us to forgive one another, contradicting the notion of holding grudges.

questions.question: True or False: The peace of God should rule in our hearts according to Colossians 3:15.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:15 affirms that the peace of God should govern our hearts, promoting unity and thankfulness.

questions.question: True or False: Wives are encouraged to lead their husbands according to Colossians 3:18.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:18 instructs wives to submit to their husbands, not to lead them, reflecting the biblical order of the family.

hard.title: Colossians Chapter 3 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Colossians Chapter 3.

questions.question: What instruction is given to husbands in Colossians 3:19?
options: Be the head of the household
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:19 states, 'Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.' This instruction emphasizes the importance of love in the marital relationship.

questions.question: What are children instructed to do in Colossians 3:20?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:20 says, 'Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.' This emphasizes the expectation of obedience from children.

questions.question: According to Colossians 3:21, how should fathers treat their children?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:21 instructs, 'Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.' This indicates that fathers should encourage rather than provoke their children.

questions.question: What is said about servants in Colossians 3:22?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:22 states, 'Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh...' indicating the expectation of obedience from servants.

questions.question: What does Colossians 3:23 encourage believers to do?
options: Do all as to the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Do all as to the Lord
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:23 says, 'And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;' highlighting the importance of dedicating all actions to God.

questions.question: What promise is given in Colossians 3:24?
options: You shall receive the reward of the inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: You shall receive the reward of the inheritance
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:24 states, 'Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.' This assures believers of their reward for serving Christ.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'agape' in Colossians 3:19 mean?
questions.explanation: 'Agape' refers to selfless, unconditional love, which is what husbands are called to have for their wives in Colossians 3:19.

questions.question: Which literary device is used in Colossians 3:14?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:14 uses inclusio by framing the concept of love as central to the virtues listed, emphasizing charity as the bond of perfectness.

questions.question: Which Old Testament commandment connects to the instruction in Colossians 3:20?
questions.explanation: Exodus 20:12 states 'Honor thy father and thy mother,' which relates directly to the instruction given in Colossians 3:20 for children to obey their parents.

questions.question: Which verse from Ephesians echoes the sentiment of Colossians 3:19 regarding husbands?
questions.explanation: Ephesians 5:25 states, 'Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church,' echoing the message found in Colossians 3:19.

questions.question: What verse precedes Colossians 3:22?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:21 precedes Colossians 3:22, providing context for the roles of fathers and servants in the family and workplace.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'mortify' in Colossians 3:5?
questions.explanation: The term 'mortify' in Colossians 3:5 means to put to death, referring to the need to kill off sinful behaviors.

questions.question: What is the theme of forgiveness present in Colossians 3:13?
options: Forgive others as God forgave you
questions.correctAnswer: Forgive others as God forgave you
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:13 states, 'Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.' This emphasizes the importance of extending forgiveness.

questions.question: True or False: Colossians 3:25 states that there is respect of persons when it comes to wrongdoing.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:25 states, '...and there is no respect of persons.' This indicates that God's judgment is impartial.

questions.question: True or False: Colossians 3:24 promises believers a reward for their service to the Lord.
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:24 assures believers, 'Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance...' confirming that service to the Lord is rewarded.

theological.title: Colossians Chapter 3 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Colossians Chapter 3 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Colossians 3:3 teach about the believer's union with Christ and its effect on human nature?
options: Believers are spiritually dead and their life is hidden with Christ in God
Believers are physically alive but spiritually separated from Christ
Believers retain their old sinful nature despite union with Christ
Believers become gods by nature through union with Christ
questions.correctAnswer: Believers are spiritually dead and their life is hidden with Christ in God
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:3 states, 'For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God,' teaching that through union with Christ believers are considered dead to their old nature and their new life is securely hidden with Christ.

questions.question: What doctrine does Colossians 3:10 teach about sanctification and the believer's renewal?
options: Believers are renewed in knowledge after the image of their Creator
Sanctification is a legalistic process of self-improvement
Renewal happens only through external rituals
questions.correctAnswer: Believers are renewed in knowledge after the image of their Creator
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:10 speaks of putting on the new man, 'which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him,' emphasizing the ongoing process of sanctification by renewal in the knowledge of God’s image.

questions.question: What doctrine does Colossians 3:11 teach about the unity of the church in Christ transcending human distinctions?
options: In Christ, distinctions such as Greek/Jew and bond/free are abolished, expressing unity
Cultural and social distinctions remain barriers in the church
Only Jews are truly part of God’s people
questions.correctAnswer: In Christ, distinctions such as Greek/Jew and bond/free are abolished, expressing unity
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:11 states that 'there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all,' teaching the doctrine of the church’s unity beyond ethnic and social distinctions.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Colossians 3:13 specifically demonstrate in the context of Christian relationships?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:13 exhorts believers to 'forbear one another, and forgive one another,' reflecting God’s attribute of longsuffering (patience) in enduring human sin and failures.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is especially highlighted in Colossians 3:25 regarding God's impartial judgment?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:25 states, 'there is no respect of persons,' emphasizing God’s justice and impartiality in judgment.

questions.question: How does Colossians 3:1–2 connect to the biblical theme of the believer's heavenly citizenship as found elsewhere in Scripture?
options: It aligns with Philippians 3:20 in teaching believers to set their minds on things above
It contradicts the Old Testament focus on earthly kingdoms
It teaches withdrawal from all social responsibilities
It emphasizes material prosperity as a sign of divine favor
questions.correctAnswer: It aligns with Philippians 3:20 in teaching believers to set their minds on things above
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:1–2 instructs believers to seek and set their affection on things above, which corresponds with Philippians 3:20's teaching about the heavenly citizenship of Christians.

questions.question: What redemptive-historical connection is made by Colossians 3:5 regarding mortifying earthly members and the Old Testament concept of holiness?
options: It fulfills Levitical calls to holiness by spiritualizing them in Christ
It rejects Old Testament laws as irrelevant
It teaches that physical acts alone achieve sanctification
It advocates legalistic self-denial without grace
questions.correctAnswer: It fulfills Levitical calls to holiness by spiritualizing them in Christ
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:5’s call to mortify earthly members echoes Old Testament holiness codes but moves beyond them by spiritualizing sanctification through union with Christ.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Colossians 3:12 and 3:14 teach about the nature of Christian virtue?
options: Christian virtues are to be put on as garments and are bound together by charity
Virtues are optional add-ons to faith, not essential
Charity is independent from other virtues
Virtue is primarily about external behavior without inner transformation
questions.correctAnswer: Christian virtues are to be put on as garments and are bound together by charity
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:12 commands believers to 'put on' virtues, and 3:14 states 'above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness,' teaching that Christian virtues are like garments unified by love.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Colossians 3:9 and 3:10 teach about the believer’s transformation?
options: The old man is put off and the new man is renewed in knowledge after the Creator's image
Transformation is only an external change with no inward renewal
Old sinful habits remain despite conversion
Renewal happens apart from knowledge of God
questions.correctAnswer: The old man is put off and the new man is renewed in knowledge after the Creator's image
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:9 forbids lying because the old man with his deeds is put off, and 3:10 emphasizes putting on the new man renewed in knowledge, teaching the comprehensive nature of transformation.

questions.question: What combined doctrine about Christian service and motivation do Colossians 3:22 and 3:23 teach?
options: Service must be done sincerely as to the Lord and not as mere men-pleasing
Service is only required if it benefits the servant
Service is optional and unrelated to spiritual life
Service should focus on impressing earthly masters
questions.correctAnswer: Service must be done sincerely as to the Lord and not as mere men-pleasing
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:22 instructs servants to obey 'not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God' and 3:23 commands to do all work 'heartily, as to the Lord,' emphasizing sincere service motivated by reverence for God.

questions.question: Sceptics claim Colossians 3:18-21 promotes oppressive hierarchical relationships. What does Colossians 3:18-21 actually teach about Christian household order?
options: It teaches mutual responsibilities with love and respect within the household context
It mandates absolute authoritarian control without love
It teaches submission only for social convenience, not spiritual reasons
questions.correctAnswer: It teaches mutual responsibilities with love and respect within the household context
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:18-21 balances commands to wives, husbands, children, and fathers, emphasizing love, respect, and avoiding provocation, which reflects a harmonious Christian household rather than oppression.

questions.question: What doctrine does Colossians 3:6 teach about the consequences of disobedience and sin in human nature?
options: God’s wrath comes on the children of disobedience
Sin has no real impact on divine judgment
Disobedience is a minor issue in the Christian life
questions.correctAnswer: God’s wrath comes on the children of disobedience
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:6 clearly states that 'for which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience,' teaching the serious divine consequence of continuing in sin.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is demonstrated in Colossians 3:15 by the call to let the peace of God rule in believers’ hearts?
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:15 commands believers to let 'the peace of God rule in your hearts,' highlighting God’s attribute as the giver of peace.

questions.question: What redemptive-historical connection does Colossians 3:16 establish about the role of Scripture and worship in Christian formation?
options: The word of Christ dwelling richly in wisdom through teaching and singing fulfills Old Testament worship and instruction patterns
It dismisses the use of psalms and hymns as outdated
Scripture is irrelevant to Christian community life
Worship should be silent and devoid of music
questions.correctAnswer: The word of Christ dwelling richly in wisdom through teaching and singing fulfills Old Testament worship and instruction patterns
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:16 encourages teaching and admonishing with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, continuing the biblical tradition of worship and instruction seen in the Old Testament.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Colossians 3:4 and 3:24 teach about the believer's future hope and present motivation?
options: Believers will appear with Christ in glory and serve with the motivation of receiving an inheritance from the Lord
Believers should focus only on present earthly rewards
Service is irrelevant to eternal reward
questions.correctAnswer: Believers will appear with Christ in glory and serve with the motivation of receiving an inheritance from the Lord
questions.explanation: Colossians 3:4 promises believers will appear with Christ in glory, and 3:24 teaches that service is done with the awareness of receiving a reward from the Lord, linking future hope with present obedience.
